chunks.arabic_text: رِجَالُ الْكَشِّيِّ: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ، عَنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ نَصِيرٍ وَجَبْرَائِيلَ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ، عَنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى، عَنِ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَقْطِينَ قَالَ

translations.en: Rijal al-Kashi: Muhammad ibn Mas'ud, from Muhammad ibn Nusayr and Jibril ibn Ahmad, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yaqub ibn Yaqtin who said:

chunks.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ الْخُرَاسَانِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ يَقُولُ: أَمَّا إِنَّ عَلِيَّ بْنَ يَقْطِينَ مَضَى وَصَاحِبُهُ عَنْهُ رَاضٍ

translations.en: I heard Abu al-Hasan al-Khurasani (peace be upon him) say: As for Ali ibn Yaqtin, he left [this world] while his master was pleased with him.

en.summary: This narration from Rijal al-Kashi highlights the spiritual status of Ali ibn Yaqtin, a prominent companion of the Imams, by affirming that he passed away in a state of divine pleasure (rida) from Imam Musa al-Kadhim (AS). It underscores the Shia concept of the Imam's authority to validate the spiritual standing of his close associates, serving as a benchmark for the authenticity of their transmitted traditions.
en.seo_question: What was the spiritual status of Ali ibn Yaqtin at the time of his death according to Imam al-Kadhim?

key_terms.رَاضٍ: pleased or satisfied (referring to the Imam's approval)
